$comment: Faults that expose a bug not yet fixed, with the bead that owns the fix. This list only shrinks: catalogue.selftest.test.ts fails on an entry origin/master does not have, and transport-faults.test.ts fails once a listed fault stops reproducing.

gaps.reason: Page 1 is cached before pages 2..N arrive. When page 2 exhausts its retries, the call-level retry re-requests page 1 with If-None-Match and the exchange derails (PAGINATION.md Known gaps #3).
Page 1 is cached before pages 2..N arrive, so a later page failing leaves page 1 alone in the cache, served as if complete on the next call inside the TTL or after a 304.
Statuses missing from STATUS_MESSAGES fall back to response.statusText, which HTTP/2 never sends, so a 502 rejects with an empty message.
Retry-After is parsed with parseInt only; an HTTP-date value makes blockedUntil NaN, so the retry goes out at once and every later request in the group logs ten 'blocked for NaNs' warnings.
